newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European fuel oil bunkers steady, gas oil dips.
newsitem.headline: European fuel oil bunkers steady, gas oil dips.

text.p: European bunker fuel oil bunker prices were steady on Tuesday with supply in most places relatively tight, while gas oil dipped in response to losses on futures, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers were offered in a $112/$114 fob range in a market with less than 10,000 tonnes of demand.

Dealers said certain players were able to offer at the lower end of the range despite buying barges at the same level. The situation left a number of smaller traders uncertain as to the appropriate level to offer. Many also had little or no product to hand.
"The sellers don't know what level to quote. Many are sold out and they can't decide whether to go short," one trader said.
Hamburg activity was thin. Fuel oil was offered at around $116.
Mediterranean business was also sluggish with many buyers expecting weakness soon.
The Durban bunker market still suffered from a shortage of product. One refinery undergoing maintenance was expected to be back by the end of the week, relieving supply difficulties.
Fujairah bunkers were firm on strong regional demand.
